paite: Ka hai deuhna uah noute'n Pathian ah na hon thuak theih uh ka ut hi. Ahi, thuak leng na hon thuak theita uhi!
heading: Paul Leh Sawltak Takloute

paite: Pathian hazatna, thikthuse khop in ahi nou ka hon hazat; Khrist kiang a nungak siangthou bang a ka hon piaktheihna ding in, pasal khat ka hon hawisak hi.
Himahleh gul in azuau pil a Evi akhem bang in, Khrist lam a takna leh sianthouna a kipan bangchi hiam in na lungsim uh ahihse kha ding, chih ka lauthawng hi.
Khattei hong pai a Jesu dang, athu ka gen ngei louh uh, agen a, kha lamdang na muh ngei louh uh leh tanchinhoih lamdang na san ngei louh uh, na pom pah un kipe baih lua na himah kei ding ua hia!
Hiai Sawltaklian thuneipen na chihte uh sang in bang lam peuh ah niamzawkna nei in ka kigingta kei hi.
Thugen lam ah pau zatsiam kei mah leng theihna ah zaw huchibang ka hi kei uhi; huai noute kiang ah bang lam peuh leh thil tengteng ah ka kilangsak uhi.
Ahihkeileh, Pathian tanchinhoih athawn lel a ka hon hilh ziak a tawisan a na omtheihna ding ua ka kihihniam in thil ka hihkhial a hia?
Na nna uh ka septheihna ding in midangte a kipan huhna la in, saptuam pawl dangte ka lok ahi.

Huan na kiang ua ka om a, ka taksap lai in, kuamah ka hon hihbuai kei a; unau Masidonia gam a kipan a hong paite'n ka taksap awng ahong huksak ngal ua; bangkim ah noumau hihbuai lou in ka kibawl bang in, ka kibawl zel lai ding hi.
Khrist thutak kei mah a a-om bang in, hiai ka kisuanna zaw Akhaia gam lam ah hihdaih in a-om kei ding.
Bangziak in? K'on it louh ziak hia? Pathian in ka hon it lam athei hi.
Huan anasep uh kisaktheihpih a, kou sep bangbang a sem kichite kichihna ka bulkalh theihna ding in ka sep tuh ka sem zom zel ding hi.
Mi huchibangte zaw Khrist sawltak akibawltawm a, sawltak takloute, nasemmi, mikhem hatte ahi uhi.
Huai ahihleh alamdang kei; Setan hial leng vak sawltak in akibawltawm nak ahi.
Huaiziak in anasemte leng diktatna nasemmi in kibawltawm mah le uh thillamdang ahi kei; huaite tawpna zaw athilhih bang zel un ahi ding hi.
Ka chi nawn ahi, kuamah in mihai in hon sep kei uhen; himahleh na hon seh vanglak uleh, ke'n leng neuchik bek a ka kisaktheih sam theihna ding in mihai bangtak in hon pom un.
heading: Sawltak Hihna Ziak A Paul Thuakna

paite: Ka gen zaw Toupa thuneihna in ka gen kei a, ka kisaktheihna mihai bangtak in ka gen zaw ahi.
Mi tampite'n khovel thilte akisaktheihpih ziak un kei leng ka hong kisathei sam ding hi.
Nou bel mipil na hih ziak un mihaite lungkimtak in na thuakzou zel uhi.
Mi sal a hon bawlte, hon negaite, nuamtak hon sa a na tung ua kiliansak leh na mai ua hon bengte na thuak thei zel ngal ua.
Kisitna dan in ka gen ahi, huchi dia zaw hat lou lua mah kei ve ua!
Amaute Hebru mi ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi. Israel mi ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi. Abraham suante ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi.
Khrist nasemte ahi uhia? Mihai bang in gen taleng, ka hi sem; sepgimna ah thupi sem in, suangkul tanna ah bang thupi sem in, vuakna ah bang akan-aval in, sih lauhuaina tamveipi ka tuak hi.
Judate lak ah vuakna khatvei a sawmli ching lou ngavei ka tuak hi.
Thumvei chiang a khet in ka om a, khatvei suang a den in ka om hi, thumvei longsiatna ka tuak a, zan khat leh ni khat tuipi ah taihmang in ka om hi.

Khualzinna ah tamveipi, luite lak ah lauhuai, suamhatte lak ah lauhuai, ka chipihte lak ah lauhuai, Zentelte lak ah lauhuai, khopi ah lauhuai, gamdai ah lauhuai, tuipi ah lauhuai, unau takloute lak ah lauhuai;
septawlna leh sepgimna, ihmutmohna ah tamveipi, gilkial leh dangtakna ah, an ngawlna ah tamveipi, khosik leh vuaktang a omnate.
Huan hiaite ban a kigen lou saptuam pawl tengteng ka ngaihtuahna niteng a hon delh gige leng a-om hi.
Kua ahia zawngkhal a om a, ke'n ka zawnkhalpih louh? Kua ahia khelhna a puksia a, ke'n ka lunggimpih louh?
Suang ding ka hih vanglakleh ka hatlouhna lam thilte ahi ka suan ding.
Tangtawn a phat tak, Toupa Jesu' Pathian leh Pa in zuau ka genlouhdan athei hi.
Damaskas ah kumpipa Aretas nuai a gam-ukpa'n hon man ding in Damaskas khopi avengsak a;
himahleh kulhbaang tohlet ah bawm in hon khaikhia ua, huchi in akhut a kipan ka suakta hi.
